title: ImUi Color Edit Model Split v1
problem: Reduce the editor `ColorEdit` god-file risk introduced by the completed color-edit depth slices by moving pure color model, parsing, formatting, HSV/RGB conversion, coordinate math, sanitization, and accessibility text helpers into a dedicated internal model module without changing public behavior or runtime contracts.

repro.summary: Focused color-edit tests and editor IMUI policy gates prove the split preserves the completed popup/picker/numeric behavior while moving pure helpers behind `controls::color_edit::model`.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_adapter_smoke --no-fail-fast

gates.name: focused color edit tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast

gates.name: imui editor surface policy
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast

gates.name: imui editor adapter smoke
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_adapter_smoke --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This internal model split is closed. Start separate follow-ons for extracting rendering submodules, shared color fixtures, color history, palette customization, eyedropper integration, or color drag/drop payloads.
